Not for me. Faster to pick up the front sight than a laser dot. I shoot IDPA & IPSC, and have been since 92. Can't think of anybody that shoot with lasers. Red dots, yes. Lasers no. Why they make Ford's and Chevy's amigo. Fwiw, I used to think exactly as you do for likely lots of the same reasons.
